'''2007 Australian Championship Adam Radic LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Adam Radic]] at [[2007 Australian Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Patience
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
